statement: Social tax is 33% of the taxable amount (Social Tax Act § 7(1)). The employer calculates it per insured person on wages and the other taxable amounts, transfers it to the Tax and Customs Board by the 10th day of the month following the taxable period, and submits the corresponding tax return (the combined TSD) by the same date (§ 9(1)).
caveat: A monthly minimum base applies: for an employed insured person social tax is generally due on at least the statutory monthly rate, which each year's state budget act sets, so the minimum employer liability moves annually; the Tax and Customs Board publishes the current figure. Reduced rates and state-paid cases in §§ 6 and 7(2) cover special groups, not ordinary startup payroll.
